user.title: Samsung Frame
user.description: Frames found on your network. Pick one, or enter its address manually.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: Turn the TV on, then select Submit and press Allow on the TV when prompted.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Name your inputs. TV (tuner) is hidden unless enabled.

manual.title: Enter the TV manually
manual.description: No Frame was found automatically. Enter its IP address; the MAC address is optional and enables fast Wake-on-LAN.

confirm.title: Set up {name}?
confirm.description: A Samsung Frame was found at {host}.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the TV again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV no longer accepts Home Assistant's saved permission. Turn the TV on, select Submit, and press Allow on the TV.

error.cannot_connect: Could not pair with the TV. Is it on, and did you press Allow?
error.duplicate_names: Input names must be unique and not empty.

abort.not_frame: That device does not look like a Samsung Frame.
abort.smartthings_not_found: No matching SmartThings media player was found for this TV. Add the TV to the core SmartThings integration first, then try again.
abort.smartthings_missing: The SmartThings integration is not set up. Add it under Settings > Devices & services, sign in to your Samsung account, then add Samsung Frame again.
abort.smartthings_no_devices: SmartThings is set up but has no media player devices. Make sure your TV appears in SmartThings and in Home Assistant, then add Samsung Frame again.

init.title: Inputs
init.description: Rename inputs or enable the TV (tuner) input. Changes apply immediately.

error.duplicate_names: Input names must be unique and not empty.
